paper_title: Search for oscillations of fundamental constants using molecular spectroscopy
notes: Paper constrains oscillating UDM coupling to quarks/gluons (QCD sector) via molecular iodine spectroscopy. Main exclusion plot (Fig. 3) shows the combination Q_N·d = 0.999 d_gs + 0.092 d_mhat + ... vs Compton frequency (10 Hz to 1e8 Hz, i.e. ~4e-14 to ~4e-7 eV). This is closest to ScalarNucleon (coupling to nucleon/quark masses and gluons). However, numerical data points are only available as figures, not tables, so no extractable (mass, coupling) pairs could be obtained. Also constrains d_alpha (ScalarPhoton) and d_me (ScalarElectron) in Figs 4-5. Galactic halo density 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed (solar halo 1e5x also considered). | selector: figure_vision (sole candidate) | Vision: The plot y-axis is d_me (electron mass coupling), constraining variation of m_e, so the appropriate coupling type is ScalarElectron rather than ScalarNucleon despite the abstract focus on quark/gluon couplings.
